label: Electrical Engineer
summary: Two Electrical Engineering Resumes against Mechanical Engineer and Arts.
job_description:
Leidos is hiring an Electrical Engineer for site development and installation work: power distribution design, field surveys and commissioning support.

What we need:
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
- 5+ years electrical site design or infrastructure engineering experience
- Ability to travel to project sites
- Electrical design

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Experience with commercial/industrial/transportation infrastructure; Knowledge of NEC and electrical design standards; Proficiency with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, Revit; Ability to pass government background check; Power distribution; MEP coordination; Site surveys; Installation support; Compliance.
